purpose: Typed decision advice for computer use, application control and browser action selection from supplied text evidence and candidates.
scope: Text-only candidate choice, insufficiency and evidence support. Operator validates; existing shell/chrome tools actuate.

examples: Choose a browser action from supplied accessibility evidence
Evaluate whether screen-description evidence supports a next action
discovery.not_for: Image grounding, screenshot capture, coordinate detection, desktop or browser actuation, autonomous permissions, private data by default.
discovery.setup: Run offline doctor and input readiness. Explicit API execution needs safely provisioned TYPESAFE_API_KEY and reviewed public/synthetic/nonsecret metadata.
